directions: From Mitchelstown test centre in Coolnanave Industrial Park, pull out and take the 1st right onto the Cahir Road
Continue for a short distance to the roundabout and take it straight through, staying on the Cahir Road as you head towards town
After the roundabout take the next left turn, then a quick left again into a residential area heading towards Mitchelstown
Take the 1st right, then when you reach the end of the road you will be asked to pull in for a turnabout
